title: Chapter 31: Unexpected Decision
content:
Chapter 31: Unexpected Decision

Wu Qing called all the nearby puppies and hydralisks over, and he contacted Wang He through the ID card.

"Lord!"

"Let me ask you something, do you know the Flower Fairy Clan?"

"Flower Fairy Clan? I haven't seen them, but I have heard of them. They are said to be elves close to plants and very good at dealing with plants."

"Flower Fairies are generally hard to see. They are basically under the command of the great lord, responsible for cultivating and planting various rare plants."

"I heard that the evil god camp also attaches great importance to the Flower Fairy Clan."

Wang He thought carefully to see if there was anything else he missed.

"Thank you very much!"

Wu Qing didn't wait any longer and ended the call directly.

When the view switched back to the temporary camp by the lake, he found that there were only a dozen people in the Flower Fairy Clan, while there were hundreds of strong dog-headed men surrounding them.

Wu Qing originally didn't want to care about the affairs of these refugees. As long as he could pull some of the refugees to Daxia Territory to enrich the population of the territory, he would be satisfied.

So he let these refugees choose to stay or leave.

In order not to expose the location of Daxia Territory temporarily, he also emphasized that people who went to Daxia Territory could not leave for the time being.

The name of Daxia Territory was also deliberately spread by Wu Qing.

Now, no one knows which territory Daxia Territory is. As long as the reputation is spread, it will be fine. If you do a good thing, you must leave a name.

With a reputation, the system can gain Qi, which can be converted into the luck of the territory.

Perhaps, with a big reputation, according to the rules of this world, the luck of the territory will also increase.

The bear goblin tribe may soon discover Daxia Territory. The original red earth lord, the little dog head man and his men, should be able to figure it out as long as they hear about the characteristics of the Zerg.

This hiding of Daxia Territory can only be temporary.

Wu Qing is a routine precaution, which can keep Daxia Territory calm for a while.

Now, he found that these dozen or so flower fairy tribesmen seemed to have great value. The good things were delivered to their mouths. It would be a pity to let them go.

Of course, he would not admit that the scarred dog head man's words were unpleasant to hear and made him feel unhappy.

He just didn't want to do anything that didn't benefit him, but now he didn't want to do anything that didn't benefit him. Now he has both benefits and dissatisfaction, so he has to do something even if it takes some risks.

"Even if you have connections, your territory has been destroyed. I'm not afraid of the people who beat you and made you flee, so why would I be afraid of you?"

In Wu Qing's mind, this is the logic.

...

At the camp by the lake, seeing that the two puppies were indifferent to the threats of the scarred dog-headed man, the dog-headed men around them, who were dressed in plain clothes but had a military aura, all surrounded them.

Now, the crowd also knew that the situation was not good and retreated.

"I knew something bad would happen when the Flower Fairy Clan followed us. They have so many guards, why don't they go alone?"

"These Tengu Clan people just received the life-saving grace of the Lord, and now they are turning their faces?"

"They may think it's just a matter of convenience, and they won't be as grateful to the Lord as we are."

"..."

Far away, someone in the crowd was whispering.

"Boom boom!"

A large number of Zerg troops rushed over.

Although they knew that these Zerg would not target ordinary people, they still felt the strong pressure and felt a little uneasy.

The guards of the Tengu clan who escorted the Flower Fairy clan picked up their weapons and began to be alert.

There were a lot of Zerg, with puppies in front and hydralisks in the back, and some hosts flying in the air.

"Please tell your lord that we have no ill intentions. We will leave immediately after settling some private matters!"

The tone of the scarred dog-headed man slowed down. He found that these soldiers of strange races seemed unable to communicate, and he was a little panicked.

Their escort mission was very important. If they had known that such a change would happen, they should not have taken the easy way out and followed this group of refugees.

"The lord has no time to care about these trivial matters. I can make the decision here."

A host flew forward and vibrated the air with mental power, making a sound directly.

The scarred dog-headed man breathed a sigh of relief when he found someone to communicate with. His tone became more polite: "We don't want to conflict with your territory. This flower fairy tribe is the private property of our lord."

"We are ordered to escort them to the tribe. Please let them go!"

The timid but brave flower fairy girl had given up hope after seeing such a scene.

Because she knew that it was normal for the lords to protect each other. Although their tribe itself had some value, it was not enough for a lord to offend important figures of the Tengu tribe in this area.

The reason why she spoke up and wanted to go to Daxia Territory was that she saw Wu Qing actually wasting elite troops to cover the retreat for these ordinary refugees, which showed the kindness of the lord of Daxia Territory.

They didn't live well in the Tengu tribe and had some bad experiences. If they had the chance, they wanted to change their environment.

Now, they can only accept their fate.

"We have been ordered to allow the refugees here to freely choose to stay or leave."

"So, it still depends on the wishes of these girls themselves."

The host's words were no less than the sound of nature to the girls of the Flower Fairy Clan.

And to the guards of the Tengu Clan, this was equivalent to directly rejecting their request and not giving face to their lord.

And not giving face to the Tengu Clan either.

You know, it's no small matter when it comes to the Flower Fairy Clan. Even if you snatch the Lord of this camp, the Tengu Clan has plenty of ways to make you spit it out.

The scarred dog-headed man himself is a one-star strength, and there are two people in the guard team who are also one-star strength. In addition, he has some trump cards, so his strength is not weak.

But this is only relative. He is now in someone else's territory. If he really fights, he may not be able to win, and he may also hurt the Flower Fairy Clan.

It's better to let the Flower Fairy Clan go to the Great Xia Territory first, and then come back.

There are certain risks on the way to take the Flower Fairy Clan back to the clan. Now the situation in this area is complicated, and he is not sure.

After thinking about this, he pointed out half of the guards and said, "In this case, you will follow me to the Great Xia Territory!"

"Everyone else go back!"

Wu Qing didn't expect that this fierce-looking dog-headed man was actually not what he expected. The conflict he expected did not happen.

The dog-headed man's choice made it difficult for Wu Qing to find an excuse to attack. Killing without reason would have a bad impact on other refugees.

But it was better this way. He got the person first, and as for the future troubles, he would deal with them later.

The Zerg and Daxia Territory needed to face many troubles in order to develop, so there was no need to take this little thing to heart.

In the end, the matter was resolved peacefully. The girls of the Flower Fairy Clan carefully left the guards of the Tengu Clan and approached the group of puppies.

Wu Qing sent some puppies to guard these small Flower Fairy girls, and he didn't mind the scarred dog-headed man and his men watching them from the side.
